key_insight: F2LLM-v2 delivers high-quality, production-ready multilingual embeddings at eight scalable sizes (80M–14B) by combining a two-stage LLM-based training pipeline with matryoshka learning and model compression, enabling strong performance for 200+ languages including many low- and mid-resource ones.
problem_solved: Existing embedding models either lack broad multilingual coverage (especially for low-resource languages) or are too large/inefficient for many deployment scenarios; F2LLM-v2 addresses both inclusivity and efficiency without sacrificing embedding quality.
method: Curated a 60M-sample public dataset emphasizing high-quality multilingual data across 200+ languages to improve coverage for mid- and low-resource languages.
Two-stage LLM-based embedding training with matryoshka learning: progressive, size-aware training to produce a family of nested models (80M–14B) that share learned structure.
Model compression via pruning and knowledge distillation to retain performance in smaller footprints for latency- and cost-sensitive deployments.
impact: Provides practitioners a flexible set of embedding models that balance quality, multilingual inclusivity, and deployment efficiency—enabling better search, retrieval, and cross-lingual applications in production and edge settings.

paper_title: F2LLM-v2: Inclusive, Performant, and Efficient Embeddings for a Multilingual World
paper_authors: Ziyin Zhang, Zihan Liao, Hang Yu, Peng Di, Rui Wang
